info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Internal Network Operation Status API
info.description: The Internal Network Operation Status API provides real-time insights into the status of internal network operations within the IT management domain. This endpoint allows users to retrieve current operational metrics and health indicators, ensuring efficient network management and decision-making. Typical consumers include IT administrators and network engineers who rely on this information to monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues proactively. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their operational visibility and responsiveness.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of internal network operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of internal network operations within the IT management system, providing insights into functionality and performance metrics.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of internal network operations. This must contain the necessary data structure as defined in the schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the current status is returned.

GetInternalNetworkOperationStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the status of internal network operation for IT management. It is used in the context of a GET request to retrieve the current operational status.

GetInternalNetworkOperationStatusRespons.title: Network Operation Status

systemId.description: The unique identifier of the system where the operation is taking place.

environment.description: The environment in which the system operates (e.g., production, staging).

changeId.description: The unique identifier for the change that triggered this operation.

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for the operation.

plannedAt.description: The planned date and time for the operation.

serviceTier.description: The service tier associated with the operation.

availabilityTargetPercent.description: The target percentage for availability as part of the operation.

maintenanceWindow.description: The designated maintenance window for the operation.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the operation record.

version.description: The version number of the operation record.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the operation record was last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the operation status.

GetInternalNetworkOperationStatusRespons.description: Schema representing the status of an internal network operation.

Metadata.title: Metadata Information

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The identifier used to correlate logs and traces.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region in which the operation was processed.

Metadata.description: Schema representing metadata information for an operation.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes a Bearer authentication method, where the client must provide a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header of the request. The token is used to verify the identity of the client and determine access permissions.
